description: Land Acquisition - Meegahawela, Natthandiya D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular land parcel (0.0213 Hectare) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed land description, location (Nattandiya Meda Palatha, Puttalam District), boundaries, and lot numbers. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of announcing land acquisition, making it primarily a land-related matter that fits Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisitions and property matters.
